adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders `@embedding` without applying any params (new file `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `def update`). However, the client-side `saveChanges` action calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` with an empty payload, and the new `embedding.hbs` template never invokes `saveChanges` at all (only `addHost`/`deleteHost` are used). So the claim that “settings submitted through this endpoint are dropped while it reports success” isn’t directly supported by the diff, but the presence of a PUT route with a no-op `update` is a real, diff-grounded incompleteness/behavior concern if anything does call it.
